manualDrafts.body:
🏙️ SAMANA Downtown One — SAMANA Developers

A new residential launch in Downtown Jebel Ali, Jebel Ali Industrial 2, Dubai — not Downtown Dubai.

• Studios, 1- and 2-bedroom apartments
• Studios from AED 689,000, officially advertised, subject to availability
• PDC plan: 10% down + 1% monthly for 80 months
• Non-PDC plan: 15% down + 1% monthly for 75 months
• Both plans also include 5% in month 6 and 5% in month 12
• Expected handover: December 2029

Official release: 13 October 2026. Alnair reported EOI access on 14 October, quoting AED 40,000; refund and allocation conditions remain unverified. PDC means post-dated cheques; eligibility applies.

Broker angle: a lower-entry residential option near Dubai’s southern employment corridor, with payments extending beyond expected handover. Rental income is not guaranteed to cover instalments.

Confidence: high for official project, studio price and plans; medium for EOI intelligence.

https://graf.ae/launches/samana-downtown-one/

🌊 Waterfront by Missoni — Emirates Developments

A broker briefing is advertised for today, 15 October 2026, from 2–5 PM at Space42 Arena, Al Raha Beach, Abu Dhabi. This is the event venue — the project is reported in Shams Abu Dhabi, Al Reem Island.

• Reported collection: 250 residences across 38 residential floors
• 1–4-bedroom apartments and two 5-bedroom penthouses
• Missoni interiors and direct beach access described in broker marketing
• Official starting price: not verified
• Final payment plan, EOI conditions and contractual handover: awaiting confirmation

Broker angle: an early branded-beachfront opportunity to assess before final pricing is released; today’s briefing is not proof that sales have opened.

Confidence: medium / broker intelligence. Final product and commercial terms require developer confirmation.

This is separate from The Bay Interiors by Missoni on Dubai Islands.

https://graf.ae/launches/emirates-waterfront-by-missoni-al-reem/

📅 Marlin Icon — Cosmo Developments

NEW UPDATE: Alnair is circulating a launch-event invitation for 16 October 2026 at Conrad Abu Dhabi, with Reportage Properties and Cosmo Developments. This follows the earlier EOI report; actual sales opening remains unverified.

📍 Canal-front Al Reem Island, Abu Dhabi; exact plot awaits confirmation.

• Broker-described 140-home scheme, including apartments and duplexes; current reported offer includes 2–4BR homes
• Broker-indicated 2BR prices from AED 1.63 million — not an official confirmed price
• Reported EOI: AED 50,000; refund conditions unverified
• Reported options: 10%, 20% or 30% down with 1% monthly; full signed schedules and final balances unverified
• Broker-advertised completion: Q4 2030

Broker angle: the newly circulated event date gives a concrete point to check launch inventory and final terms, rather than rely on preliminary advertisements.

Confidence: medium / broker intelligence. Developer event confirmation and final commercial documents remain pending.

https://graf.ae/launches/cosmo-marlin-icon-al-reem-island/
